name: American Oak Rustic
originalDescription:
American Oak has become a sought-after choice in Australian homes, loved for its distinctive open grain patterns, natural warmth and timeless appeal. Its beautiful colour palette ranges from soft honey and golden browns to lighter, understated earthy tones, creating depth and character in any space.

Grown predominantly across the eastern United States, American Oak makes a striking feature floor, bringing effortless sophistication to both contemporary and classic interiors. Available in Prime and Rustic grades to suit a variety of design preferences.

name: Grey Iron Bark
originalDescription:
Renowned for its exceptional strength and natural beauty, Grey Ironbark showcases a rich palette of deep chocolate, warm reddish-brown and soft honey tones. Its distinctive grain and natural colour variations create a beautifully individual timber floor, full of warmth and character.

One of Australia's hardest hardwoods, Grey Ironbark offers outstanding durability, making it an exceptional choice for both residential and high-traffic commercial timber flooring. Native to the coastal regions of New South Wales and southern Queensland, it brings enduring Australian character to any interior.

name: Spotted Gum
originalDescription:
Spotted Gum is one of Australia's most sought-after native hardwoods, celebrated for its distinctive back-sawn grain, striking natural variation and rich palette of colours, ranging from soft creams and warm honey tones to deep, earthy browns.

Native to the coastal regions of New South Wales and Queensland, Spotted Gum takes its name from the distinctive spotted markings that develop as the tree sheds its bark in strips.

Renowned for its strength and durability, Spotted Gum has a Janka hardness rating of approximately 11kN, making it an excellent choice for beautiful, hard-wearing timber flooring.

name: Tasmanian Driftwood
originalDescription:
Tasmanian Driftwood is a beautiful solid timber flooring option, crafted from a blend of Tasmanian timber species. Inspired by the natural beauty of weathered driftwood, its soft, muted tones, gentle colour variation and subtle grain detailing create a relaxed yet refined aesthetic.

With its lightly featured appearance and organic character, Tasmanian Driftwood brings warmth and understated elegance to both contemporary and country-inspired interiors.

name: Tasmanian Oak
originalDescription:
A timeless Australian favourite, Tasmanian Oak has stood the test of time for its natural warmth, understated elegance and versatility. Valued for its beautiful light tones, subtle pink and honey hues, and characterful straight grain, it brings a sense of warmth and sophistication to both contemporary and classic interiors.

Our popular extra-wide 185mm boards create a beautiful sense of space, with a water-based finish enhancing the natural colour and grain of the timber.
